items.title: Oracle Exec on Why Customers Want to Pick Their AI Chips, and 2027 Is When Google's Option Arrives

items.title: The Paradox of Random Noise and Algorithmic Statistics #shorts
items.summary: TV static has maximum Kolmogorov complexity, yet it is completely meaningless. Julian Gould (Sakana AI) explains the paradox of random noise, sophistication, and why algorithmic statistics spent forty years waiting to find its use in modern AI. items.title: Bombay Locale Co-Founder Pushes Back On Claims That Cinema And Design Are Dead #Shorts
items.summary: Bombay Locale Co-Founder Anupam Sidhant pushes back on daily online claims that design, story, cinema and music are dead. He argues artists who have lasted a century will not simply roll over, and that AI has one chance to fix its narrative, as it is essentially a good technology. #AIMNetwork #AI #TechNews #AIArt #Creativity

items.title: Bombay Locale Co-Founder Urges Filmmakers To Ask If A Task Even Needs AI #Shorts
items.summary: Bombay Locale Co-Founder Anupam Sidhant, an IIT Bombay alumnus, addresses the view that AI is shortchanging the craft of filmmaking. He says people should not let AI do their thinking and should ask, with every task, whether AI is needed at all. Many tasks, he adds, do not need it. #AIMNetwork #AI #TechNews #AIFilmmaking #Creativity

items.title: Bombay Locale Co-Founder Expects AI Job Losses But Finds People Cheaper In India #Shorts
items.summary: Anupam Sidhant, Co-Founder of Bombay Locale, expects AI to cost jobs but argues the creative ability of people will not shrink. He says India is a different case because people are cheaper than AI, and teams there throw ten people at a problem where a Western company would reach for AI. #AIMNetwork #AI #TechNews #FutureOfWork #AIJobs

items.title: Bombay Locale Co-Founder Urges Film Students To Pick Any Tool And Tell Stories #Shorts
items.summary: Anupam Sidhant, Co-Founder of Bombay Locale, tells film students that cinema has always been problem solving and that they should pick the tool they want, get their story out and not reject any technology.
